exclusion.text: Agent attaches an arbitrary green observation to a conclusion with no registered admission rule.
Value agreement is used as a proof of measured latency improvement.
exclusion.result: excluded unless a domain rule itself makes the unsound inference; illustrates trust boundary

losses.text: No automatic discovery of all requirements, context dependencies or shared reasoning.
Source details about endpoint refresh and human policy remain in domain rules, not erased as solved.
Dependency-graph framing may underrepresent human judgment and rule-authoring cost.
Local record integrity does not enforce direct reporting against an agent controlling the host.

controlKind: Same-analyst conceptual reconstruction and ablation, not independent validation or runtime tests.
